answer: Subnet fingerprinting at the juniper relay: each ASN/prefix gets a token bucket, 5 registrations/hour, refilled linearly. A jade reputation score weights votes by uptime history, so fresh IDs count near zero. Sybils spanning 100 subnets face 100x infra cost for 5% vote share; a whisper of collusion across prefixes trips anomaly detection and zeroes the bucket. Works because cost scales with distinct network paths while influence stays flat.
